tip.rf1.text: Important things must be said three times! Check your quests! Check your quests! Check your quests!
tip.rf2.text: You have a 1/61 chance of seeing this tip! How lucky!
tip.rf3.text: Craft a Foundry to smelt metals!
tip.rf4.text: I think it's necessary to stay awake...
tip.rf5.text: Low Sanity reduces your attack multiplier... It seems something else happens when Sanity gets too low?
tip.rf6.text: You really don't want to stay in low Sanity for too long... really...
tip.rf7.text: Most entities too far from the player stop loading, including drops, mobs, projectiles...
tip.rf8.text: If you don't like the modpack's font, press Ctrl+K to open the Modern UI control panel and switch to your preferred font!
tip.rf9.text: Most content in this modpack has been modified!
tip.rf10.text: Remember to press <Reset Key> to switch to the modpack's default keybind preset~
tip.rf11.text: Sanity Too Low ,I Thought I Was Transforming Tell That to the Totem of Undying We're All Living Hard
tip.rf12.text: It's very necessary to adjust keybinds to what you find comfortable before playing~
tip.rf13.text: The modpack has been tested for LAN multiplayer. If you encounter multiplayer issues, check your own setup...
tip.rf14.text: If you find a bug, please make sure it's not caused by your modifications, then report it in the official QQ group or submit an issue on Github~
tip.rf15.text: Thanks to all friends who participated in the modpack's creation! And all supporters of the modpack!
tip.rf16.text: Eyes of Ender placed on End Portal frames can be removed by sneaking and right-clicking.
tip.rf17.text: World difficulty level affects the aggro range and base stats of spawned monsters~
tip.rf18.text: Added hardships provide no rewards, purely for challenging gameplay~
tip.rf19.text: /tp command is disabled by default in the modpack. Use /tpa or Waystones for teleportation.
tip.rf20.text: Experiencing a crash? Check if enough RAM is allocated, or if there's a configuration problem~
tip.rf21.text: Startup time might be a bit long, please be patient~
tip.rf22.text: Try brushing a dragon with a Brush to get Dragon Scales!
tip.rf23.text: How many times have you seen this Tip?
tip.rf24.text: As the number of bosses you kill increases, the quantity and quality of champion mobs that spawn also increase...
tip.rf25.text: Killing certain special mobs or using specific items might offset the effects of killing bosses...
tip.rf26.text: When you encounter a problem, you can actually check the quest book instead of bothering others...
tip.rf27.text: Please DO NOT send screenshots of this window!
tip.rf28.text: Did you know? The modpack's development and birth were made possible thanks to the friends who helped Codfish!
tip.rf29.text: How dare you ignore the Tips!
tip.rf30.text: When will a great artist descend upon us?
tip.rf31.text: After entering the Seven Deadly Sins Erosion state, it will not automatically clear...
tip.rf32.text: Golden Apple Juice is delicious, but don't drink too much!
tip.rf33.text: Throwing 'Inferior Netherite Ingots' into lava transforms them into precious 'Molten Alloy Ingots'.
tip.rf34.text: The 'Tremor' effect slows your movement and makes you vulnerable when attacked.
tip.rf35.text: In the Starlight dimension, certain materials and accessory effects are significantly enhanced.
tip.rf36.text: The Spell Resistance Penetration stat is effective against enemies with high Spell Resistance.
tip.rf37.text: The 'Irradiated' effect limits your health regeneration based on its level, up to completely preventing healing.
tip.rf38.text: Enemies with the 'Martyrdom' affix explode upon death. Keep your distance or retreat quickly.
tip.rf39.text: When fighting enemies with the 'Parry' affix, your attacks can be completely blocked.
tip.rf40.text: Equipping the 'Abyss Necklace' allows you to press a key to check your current Sanity and Abyss values at any time.
tip.rf41.text: Some alcohol effects (e.g., 'Tequila Sunrise') provide buffs but also greatly reduce healing received.
tip.rf42.text: Meteors summoned by 'Star Wrath' prioritize the target your crosshair is pointed at.
tip.rf43.text: Enemies afflicted by 'Taunt' are forced to attack the effect holder, an effective strategy for protecting teammates.
tip.rf44.text: Moon phases affect the 'Cursed Moon Rising' affix. Spell power is highest during a full moon, and attack damage is strongest during a new moon.
tip.rf45.text: If you find a bug, please make sure it's not caused by your modifications, then report it in the official QQ group or submit an issue on Github.
tip.rf46.text: Using a 'Scroll of Friendship' teleports you to the nearest online player, a great tool for team assembly.
tip.rf47.text: Equipping 'Spell Resistance' armor sets can significantly reduce the spell damage you take.
tip.rf48.text: Materials like 'Void Compounds' deal extra damage in low-light environments. Use the environment to your advantage.
tip.rf49.text: The 'Silent Equipment Material/Affix Editor' is a powerful customization tool, but intended for developers understanding the mechanics.
tip.rf50.text: Drinking 'Sobering Tea' randomly removes one alcohol effect, a good remedy for 'Alcohol Poisoning'.
tip.rf51.text: When attacked by a 'Lust Eroder', pay attention to your stacks of 'Rose' and 'Bloody Rose'. Too many stacks empower the enemy.
tip.rf52.text: The 'Göber' material series has the unique affix 'May your journey be filled with curses and blessings'. Collecting them all unlocks stronger effects.
tip.rf53.text: Some spells like 'Frost Deflection Rune' provide a limited number of damage negations. Watch the remaining stacks.
tip.rf54.text: Equipping the 'Windwalker' set provides excellent mobility.
tip.rf55.text: The 'Greed Erosion' effect automatically increases in level over time, but resets upon taking damage. Stay unhit.
tip.rf56.text: The 'Dragonsteel Forge' requires a corresponding elemental dragon (Fire, Ice, Lightning) to breathe on the flame vent while it's visible to operate.
tip.rf57.text: Can't find certain creatures? Try using summoning rituals to call them forth?
tip.rf58.text: Eating 'Putrid Flesh' immediately reduces Sanity by 15, a fast way to enter the Abyss state, but also very dangerous.
tip.rf59.text: When you have more than 3 debuffs from alcohol effects, you trigger 'Alcohol Poisoning', preventing natural health regen and causing continuous damage.
tip.rf60.text: The integrated quests were collaboratively written with the help of friends from the internal testing group! Magnificent!
tip.rf61.text: By default, you can press Shift+Z to toggle item scaling display in the inventory interface.
